children: Quantum Cyber appointed David Caplon as CFO, effective November 20, 2026, following William Caragol’s resignation.
Chief Financial Officer; principal financial and accounting officer
Resigned; entered into a consulting agreement
Appointed; entered into an executive employment agreement
Appointed in connection with Caragol’s resignation
Quantum Cyber Controller since June 2026; previously held controller and accounting roles, including at CapForce. CPA with a bachelor’s degree in accounting and finance.
Consulting fee of $15,000 per month. Existing equity awards continue vesting on schedule and remain outstanding and exercisable through their original ten-year terms.

$270,000 annualized base salary; target annual cash bonus of 100% of salary; annual equity awards with grant-date value up to the greater of 250,000 ordinary shares or 100% of salary. Initial 12-month term, then automatic six-month renewals. Granted an option for 170,000 shares, vesting in 18 substantially equal monthly installments. Agreement includes severance provisions.

title: Quantum Cyber names David Caplon CFO as William Caragol resigns
